title: Record OWN-069 to OWN-071: weather intelligence (ADR-008), remote-server alerting, weeks 1-7 capture

review.summary: Owner reply 2026-11-22: Q-016 yes for non-closed stadiums, via a multi-source weather intelligence system (Open-Meteo, NOAA RRFS, NWS/NBM, ECMWF/AIFS, NOAA historical/Meteostat), refreshed as kickoff nears, little weight indoors; owner findings: RRFS operational 2026-11-03 and observed vs forecast weather must not be mixed. Alerting deferred to a remote 24/7 server; weeks 1-7 captured by the worker; housekeeping last. Verified (web, 2026-11-22/23): SCN 26-48 updated and SCN 26-89 set RRFS/REFS live 2026-11-03 12 UTC replacing NAM, HREF, SREF, HiresW; HRRR stays (correction to the owner's note); NOMADS prod paths observed 2026-11-23: nam 404, rrfs 200, hrrr 200. Open-Meteo free tier non-commercial, <10k/day, 5k/h, 600/min, CC BY 4.0; Previous Runs API from Jan 2024; Single Runs ECMWF IFS from Mar 2024, others from 2026-04-02. ECMWF open data CC-BY-4.0, AIFS free, AWS replica. NWS API no key, User-Agent with contact required. NBM on AWS noaa-nbm-grib2-pds, text bulletins. GHCNh replaces ISD. Meteostat licence statements conflict (CC BY vs CC BY-NC). nflverse play_by_play: roof and surface pre-game, stadium_id identity, temp and wind after the game; no venue coordinates in the repo.
